dispositions.reason: The supplied source and terminology note establish the text-message display name as “Designer-Brand Junkie.”
The repeated first-person possessives and verbs state that Choi trusts his own instincts and judgment, not that unspecified Guild members trust him.
The Guild Master explicitly fires Kim Sangshik and orders HR to remove both father and son, so “terminations” preserves the established action.
The surrounding scene establishes that the father and son were forced out rather than voluntarily resigning.
The named technique 일섬 is established in the supplied terminology as “One Annihilation.”
방언 describes ecstatic speaking in tongues in this joke, whereas “dialect” does not fit the ensuing stream of exclamations.
The Korean uses a future conditional, expressing what would happen if the System disappeared rather than implying repeated disappearances.
The playful sobriquet 김 여사 is established as “Lady Kim,” not the ordinary marital title “Mrs. Kim.”
The address 김 여사님 continues the established playful “Lady Kim” sobriquet.
The source says Taekyung repeatedly spoke or called out Jin Wikyung’s name, so the replacement restores the missing referent.
